connector.name: TradeOS Public Intelligence
connector.registryDescription: Crypto market intelligence, evidence, watchlists, feedback, and paid x402 SKU routing.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package tradeos-public-intel-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the agenticsrclab account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: TRADEOS_API_BASE
env.description: Optional TradeOS public intelligence API base URL.

env.name: TRADEOS_PUBLIC_INTEL_KEY
env.description: Optional public-intel app key for attribution and quota confidence.

env.name: TRADEOS_ACCOUNT_TOKEN
env.description: Optional account token for user-owned watchlist tools.

env.name: TRADEOS_X402_BASE_URL
env.description: Optional TradeOS x402 gateway base URL.

env.name: TRADEOS_X402_AGENT_ID
env.description: Optional stable agent or host identifier used for x402 attribution.

env.name: TRADEOS_X402_PAYMENT_HEADER
env.description: Optional one-time buyer-signed x402 payment header for explicit paid calls. Do not use for private keys.

env.name: TRADEOS_X402_WALLET_ADDRESS
env.description: Optional buyer wallet address sent with explicit paid x402 calls.
